It’s always within reach - get support that fits your schedule. Get help What is an AI recruiter agent? An AI recruiter agent helps teams manage the thinking and coordination behind hiring. It supports role definition, resume screening, candidate evaluation, interview preparation, and hiring decisions-  so teams spend less time sorting information and more time choosing the right people. Why use AI in recruiting? Recruiting generates large amounts of unstructured data - CVs, interviews, notes, feedback. AI in recruiting helps turn that information into clear insights, reducing manual screening and helping teams make more consistent, confident hiring decisions without rushing. How is an AI recruiter different from an ATS? An ATS stores candidates and tracks stages. Scouty helps interpret what’s inside the system: analyzing resumes, summarizing interviews, highlighting gaps, and guiding next steps - so hiring teams don’t rely only on checklists or gut feeling. Is Scouty just an AI recruitment chatbot? In a sense - yes, but Scouty is not a traditional recruitment chatbot. While you interact with her through chat, she functions as an AI recruiter agent. Scouty works across job requirements, resumes, interview feedback, and hiring goals to support screening, evaluation, and hiring decisions. Chat is simply the interface - the real value is in how she analyzes information and helps teams move candidates forward. Will Scouty replace human recruiters? No. Scouty supports recruiters and hiring managers by handling analysis, preparation, and structure. Humans remain in control of interviews, judgment, and final decisions. Scouty reduces workload - it doesn’t replace people.
